searches.reason: Develop a probe for the gap between interior masked reconstruction and appended-mask next-item prediction. On training-only held-out prefixes, compare matched targets with and without right context, then measure sensitivity to recent-history removal and order shuffling. Connect failures to supervision allocation and positional encoding; preserve reserved MASK inputs and final-nonpadding readout. Perturbation effects measure model dependence, not causal user preferences.

searches.reason: Translate qualitative feedback into evidence-backed recommendation audits using only histories, timestamps, titles and descriptions. Investigate explicit textual compatibility conflicts and rankings of direct recent-interest matches versus broad semantic matches. Require evidence spans and abstention when compatibility, ownership or immediate usefulness cannot be established; validate the audit on a small manually reviewed sample without pretrained downloads.

searches.reason: Replace reliance on single-negative margins and mean embedding cosine with a calibrated diagnostic suite: candidate-count sensitivity, training-frequency and history-length strata, embedding effective rank, and actual top-list concentration. Use fixed training-prefix probes, paired user bootstrap intervals and controlled fault injection to test whether metrics detect known defects. Keep the host evaluator unchanged and use macro validation HR@10 exclusively for model selection.
